notes: OpenCode 2.x, driven through the service API (#2109 P5a smoke cell). A long turn is interrupted over the API (POST /interrupt, the TUI Escape's API form); the 2.x plugin's session.execution.interrupted ends it, and a plain second turn proves the session recovered. Turn 2's start carries the record's min_delay_ms 1000 floor for a turn-N start (#2109 §Dwell and bounce); the post-hook ready → working → ready bounce that floor guarded against is gone since #2120 (P5-0). The recipe sends turn 2 about 4 s after turn 1's idle.

text: The API session is admitted when its first activity lands (P3, #2107): a ses_… transcript_new. Its first state is not pinned — P4's 1 Hz sampler first saw an API session as working, so V1's 'born ready within 2s' is not assumed
The session binds to the one running 2.x service (pid.go servicePIDFor) — there is no client process
The long prompt drives the session to working
The API interrupt's session.execution.interrupted reaches the daemon as a turn end (Stop)
The interrupted turn returns the session to ready; it does not stick in working
The next prompt drives working again; min_delay_ms 1000 is the record's floor for a turn-N start (#2109 §Dwell and bounce), and the post-hook bounce it guarded against is gone since #2120 (P5-0)
The second turn completes back to ready — the session recovered
